# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/labels

Replace all labels on an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-338`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `IssueLabelsOption`

|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `labels` | []any | False | each element must be integer or string, cannot mix integers and strings |

## Response

**200** — []*api.Label

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Labels array elements must be all integers or all strings, cannot mix types | validation | len(labelIDs) > 0 && len(labelNames) > 0 |
| Each label element must be a float64 (integer) or string via reflect | validation | rv.Kind() is not Float64 or String |
| User must have write permission on issues or pulls to modify labels | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Labels are only valid if they belong to the issue's repo or the repo owner's org | business_logic | l.RepoID != issue.RepoID && l.OrgID != issue.Repo.OwnerID |
| Exclusive labels: adding a label removes other labels in the same exclusive scope | business_logic | label.ExclusiveScope() != "" and another label with same scope exists |
| Label names are resolved from both repo labels and org labels when owner is organization | business_logic | ctx.Repo.Owner.IsOrganization() |
| ReplaceLabels uses sorted diff algorithm to minimize DB operations | business_logic | Always during replace |

### Error Paths

- **Issue not found** → repo.ReplaceIssueLabels → 404
- **No write permission** → repo.prepareForReplaceOrAdd → 403
- **Invalid label type** → repo.prepareForReplaceOrAdd → 400
